1. **Partial dissolution**: This suggests that some of the precipitate dissolved in NH₃. AgCl dissolves in NH₃ to form the soluble complex [Ag(NH₃)₂]⁺.

- **Hg₂²⁺ is present** (because the precipitate turned gray)
